questions.question: Modify the runCode() function. When the user clicks the button, add / remove the 'open' class from the 'panel' div.
questions.explanation: In the Run handler, attach a click listener to the button that calls panel.classList.toggle('open').

questions.question: Modify the runCode() function. When the user clicks the button, add the text from the input to the output div.
questions.explanation: Add a click listener; read input.value; set output.textContent.

questions.question: Modify the runCode() function. When the user clicks the button, append a new list item with the input text to the list.
Modify the runCode() function. When the form is submitted, prevent the default behavior and set the status text to 'Submitted'.
questions.explanation: Use e.preventDefault() in a submit handler.

questions.question: Modify the runCode() function. When the user clicks the button, change the image src so it ends with 'cat.jpg'.
questions.explanation: Add a click listener and set img.src.
